mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, content_revision, status, error_message, created_by, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_content_material_task(conversation_id, content_revision, status, created_by) values(#{conversationId}, #{contentRevision}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select from ai_content_material_task where conversation_id=#{conversationId} and content_revision=#{contentRevision}
select from ai_content_material_task where status='PENDING' order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_content_material_task set status='PROCESSING', started_at=coalesce(started_at, now()), finished_at=null, error_message=null where id=#{id} and status='PENDING'
update ai_content_material_task set status=#{status}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, finished_at=now() where id=#{id} and status='PROCESSING'
update ai_content_material_task set status='PENDING', error_message=null, finished_at=null where id=#{id} and status in ('FAILED','PARTIAL_FAILED')
update ai_content_material_task set status='FAILED', error_message='后台执行中断，请手动重试', finished_at=now() where status='PROCESSING' and updated_at < #{updatedBefore}
